theorems.name: Submission.bv_exists_smooth_cutoff
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (L O : Set (Rn n)), IsCompact L → IsOpen O → L ⊆ O → ∃ χ : Rn n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) χ ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ χ x ∧ χ x ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ x ∈ L, χ x = 1) ∧ HasCompactSupport χ ∧ tsupport χ ⊆ O
